evidence: Met: arrow keys cycle with wrap at _tabs.py:148-151; number keys activate at _tabs.py:152-153; letter search cycles matches at _tabs.py:154-163; click target includes padding since width = len(label) + 2*TAB_PADDING at _tabs.py:77; a click anywhere on the widget, including the underline row, activates the nearest tab at _tabs.py:135-138 and _tab_at at :82-100; no tabs renders an inactive underline because highlight stays (0,0) at _tabs.py:122-125.

Not met, height: _tabs.py:70 self.layout_size = 2 is never read, and dock layout sizes from styles.height (base layouts/dock.py:86-90). The widget therefore takes a fractional share of its dock area instead of 2 rows. Reference sets DEFAULT_STYLES = "height: 2;" (reference tabs.py:194).

Not met, blank row: _tabs.py:120 appends "\n" to a Text whose default end is also "\n". Rich's Text.split(allow_blank=True) keeps a trailing empty line (rich text.py:1101, 1230 in the installed rich 15.0.0 source; the project pins rich ^11.2.0 at pyproject.toml:22, and 11.2.0 was not verified). The result is an extra blank row between labels and underline. Reference uses end="" plus Segment.line() (reference tabs.py:115-124, 88).

Not met, wide characters: _tabs.py:77 uses len(label) while rendering uses cell width. CJK labels therefore misalign click hit-testing and the highlight. Reference uses cell_len(tab.label) (reference tabs.py:99).
Not met, 0 key: _tabs.py:152 ignores 0, whereas reference maps 0 to the 10th tab when there are at least 10 tabs (reference tabs.py:307-308).

Behavior difference: reference spreads tabs across the available width with auto padding (tab_padding=None; reference tabs.py:99-102 via layout_resolve). Generated packs tabs left with fixed padding 1 (_tabs.py:51).
criteria.deficiency: The behavioral intent is partly met: keyboard cycling, number keys, letter search, click-to-nearest, and the no-tabs case work. The widget does not fill its intended two-row height, renders a stray blank row above the underline, mis-measures wide-character labels, and ignores key 0. It also does not reproduce the reference's auto-width layout. The required UnderlineBar clickable_ranges behavior is missing, which the FAIL_TO_PASS test checks.
